sections.title: Share and stop sharing handlers
sections.what: POST opts the fan in and returns the image link. DELETE stops sharing, so the old link stops working.
sections.why: The comment says the share is opt-in and can be revoked, which is why stopping must work reliably.
sections.watch_out: If a DELETE fails silently, the old card stays public, so this path must be tested.

summary: Lets a fan opt in to sharing their Alter Ego card and returns the image link, or stop sharing so the old link stops working.
purpose: Gives fans control over whether their Alter Ego card is public.
why: The comment says sharing is opt-in and revocable, which is a privacy promise.
how: POST: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Opts the user in and gets a share token. 3) Returns the image link with status 201. DELETE: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Stops sharing. 3) Returns an empty response.
inputs: POST and DELETE with the session.
outputs: A JSON image link with status 201 for POST, or an empty 204 for DELETE.
risks: Stopping sharing is what makes the old image link stop working, so a failed DELETE leaves the card public.
debug: If the link still works after stopping, check the stop function in the lab service and the cache setting on the image route.
